column6: Parse an owner Slack reply into a canonical first-token outcome plus comments, or a verbatim §4.5 NACK (spec-owner-io §4). Pure; does not post.
Durable Slack outbox (spec-owner-io §7 / C-17): pending-delivery until Slack ack; local query by state/kind/channel_id/goal_id/ask_id and get-by-id.
Sends the record-owner-ask gateway intent (open | reap) for the owner-ask record. Holds no store handle: the daemon stamps open_asks (spec-state-store §3; owner ruling 2026-08-24).

Thread-per-ask posting and the ONE ask-release door (spec-owner-io §2.1/§2.4/§3): opens a new goal-channel thread per ask batch, stamps the ❓/💭 opening line with the thread id it minted, mints a record only for ❓, and releases an ask only on an authorized sender's parsed reply in that exact thread. No oldest-open and no `re:` fallback.

Wires ask-thread.js into production: builds the ask door, resolves the goal channel for postAsk (the bus ferry's ❓ leg), holds the persisted askThreads map (<channel>:<threadTs> -> goal/seat/askId), and routes an inbound message in an ask thread to release before every other leg.

The §3 approval first message (GOAL NAME + IRREVERSIBLE as their own bold lead lines, bound commit_id, published tokens) and the §4.2 post-parse dispatch keyed on the ask's kind: approve is D12 only in a genuine approval thread; reject-and-close/pause/retry, retry with:, close; the [T3-R22] three-key pause; [C-16] failure post-back into the same thread. Effects are injected ports.

The mechanical pause/resume door (spec-owner-io §4.2/§4.4/§4.5) and the resume-semantics table (spec-recovery §4 [C-14]): target resolution incl. bare verb in a goal channel, the verbatim mechanical NACK on zero/several matches, goal paused<->running, named-event re-arm of a counter-exhausted lane, refusals for blocked-on-human and gate-cap. Never releases an ask; holds no store handle.

Wires approval-thread.js and pause-resume.js into production: kind/commitId/paused on the persisted askThreads entries, the kind fork after release, the reap-suppressed later reads of a paused approval thread, and the mechanical door ahead of the master doors for top-level goal-channel and DM messages. Ports (approvalPorts, endingStore, listSeats, listLiveGoals) are injected and unwired by main().
